text.content:
Fencers achieve their keen prowess through studious dedication to their craft, honing its approaches into distinct stances.

SKILLS

PARRY STANCE · SL max 5

When you use the Guard action while wielding a melee weapon, your Guard value increases by (SL).

LUNGE STANCE · SL max 5

When you use a weapon attack with a melee weapon, you may reduce its Accuracy by (SL). If you do, your attack targets one additional creature within 2 squares of your first target.

ELEGANT RIPOSTE · SL max 1

After an enemy you can see misses you with a melee attack, you may perform a free attack with a melee weapon you have equipped.

DISARMING STRIKE · SL max 3

When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you may choose one item they have equipped. That item is no longer equipped.

DEFT FOOTWORK · SL max 3

When you use a weapon attack with a melee weapon, you may increase the MP cost by (SL × 5). If you do, you move up to 2 squares after the attack resolves.
